truth: CORE-01, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. CORE-02 and PLATFORM-00 remain preserved incomplete.

DAW-00A Peer Host Identity is implemented on mergeable draft PR #30 and DAW-00B Stable Workspace Identity is implemented on mergeable draft PR #31 head 2746c8491c33d7c070a4fcfa5814958823828024. Hosted exact-head execution remains UNOBSERVED where absent.
Global reselection chose DAW-00C because safe deictic artist intent requires exact current focus after host and workspace identity are established.
DAW-00C is the only active increment. FocusContext is volatile/read-only and is not durable Song doctrine or action authority.
Canonical dimensions are TRACK, CLIP_REGION, TIME_RANGE, MIDI_NOTES, DEVICE_PLUGIN, AUTOMATION, PLAYHEAD, ACTIVE_EDITOR and SONG_SECTION.
Focus states are OBSERVED_EXACT, OBSERVED_AMBIGUOUS, INFERRED and UNKNOWN. Only OBSERVED_EXACT satisfies exact-target requirements.
FocusContext binds workspace ID, Song ID, exact current workspace-observation ID, host-runtime fingerprint and observation evidence reference.
Workspace move/recovery or runtime-observation change makes prior focus stale. Missing, ambiguous, inferred and unknown dimensions never become guessed mutation targets.

The exact n0te2/focus.py blob c6d3ff02076aa33573fc7bcdd7472ef3b729bbbc matches the bytes that passed 14 focused local cases. Repository regressions are authored; hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
FocusContextService exposes only capture, validate_current, require_exact and exact_refs and performs no writes or host-specific selection/mutation.
No named DAW adapter, Host Shadow, feature registry, process/selection discovery, DAW mutation, MIDI/OSC/control-surface or UI implementation is included in DAW-00C.
Historical Ableton selection semantics provide zero scheduling or vocabulary priority.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
